description: This is a Java class named DefaultClientConfig that implements the ClientConfig interface. It provides configuration settings related to client connection parameters such as timeouts, retries, backoff durations, and includes a factory method for instantiation from a Config object.

classes.name: DefaultClientConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ClientConfig providing connection configuration parameters and a factory method to instantiate from a Config.

methods.name: getConnectingMinTimeout
methods.description: Returns the minimum timeout duration for connecting.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout duration for connecting.

methods.name: getSubscriptionManagerTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for the subscription manager.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTries
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of tries for connection attempts.

methods.name: getTestingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration for testing timeout.
